basic_info.description: Chic Contemporary view home perched high on a hill w/sweeping views from the North Bay & Marin Headlands to Sutro Tower & Twin Peaks to the East Bay & Mt. Davidson! A brick walkway w/gated entrance leads to large double doors & into a spacious foyer w/coat closet, grand open staircase & huge picture window w/dramatic views. The magnificent formal living rm boasts a classic fireplace w/built-in seating, bookshelves, recessed lighting, hardwood floors & a fabulous walk-out deck w/spectacular views from the East Bay to Mt. Davidson, the Southern hills & a peak to the Pacific Ocean. Banquet-size formal dining w/awesome views from the North Bay & Marin Headlands to Sutro Tower & Twin Peaks! Huge light-filled kitchen w/breakfast area & window balcony showcases a gas range & butler's pantry w/wet-bar. Splendid open staircase w/floor-to-ceiling mirror & more impressive views continues to the upper level w/4BR/2BA + laundry closet on the same floor! The master suite w/its dazzling views of Twin Peaks & the North Bay features wall-to-wall closets & a private en-suite bath w/skylight, vanity sink & walk-in shower. Wonderful family rm or guest quarters w/en-suite bath, sep enormous workshop/hobby rm below. Park-like landscaped backyard w/walkway, expansive level turf & mature plants & trees!
